subject.title: [Feature]: Time-gate progress drafts and use model preamble as status headline (narration shows for small tasks)

question: Should progress mode adopt a purely time-based ordinary-work gate and make typed model preamble the default headline across shared progress-draft channels?
rationale: This changes the default balance between immediate liveness, quiet short turns, utility-model cost, and visibility of commentary that is currently opt-in; source inspection can validate the implementation shape but cannot choose that product policy.

options.title: Adopt preamble-first time gate
options.body: Remove the second-work-event fast start, preserve explicit immediate paths, defer narration until visibility, and use sanitized fresh preamble as the headline with narration as fallback.

options.title: Time-gate only
options.body: Remove the fast start and defer narration, but retain synthetic narration as the status headline and leave typed commentary opt-in.

options.title: Keep current defaults
options.body: Retain immediate display after two work events and the current synthetic narration behavior, accepting short-turn flashes and eager utility-model work.

recommendation.title: Adopt preamble-first time gate
recommendation.body: Remove the second-work-event fast start, preserve explicit immediate paths, defer narration until visibility, and use sanitized fresh preamble as the headline with narration as fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The behavior appears to originate in their merged narrated-progress work, and this issue directly revisits that feature's intended UX.
